question: Which country did India defeat to qualify for the FIBA Men’s Asia Cup 2025?
solution:
The Correct Answer is ​__**Bahrain**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• India qualifies for FIBA Men’s Asia Cup 2025.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**India** qualified for the **FIBA Men’s Asia Cup 2025** after defeating **Bahrain** 81-77.

 
 
• 
 
The match was held at **Khalifa Sports City** in **Manama, Bahrain**.

 
 
• 
 
India’s win over Bahrain marked their first victory against them since **2013**.

 
 
• 
 
The 2025 FIBA Asia Cup will be the **31st edition of the FIBA Asia Cup**, the continental basketball championship in Asia.

 
 
• 
 
The tournament will be organised by FIBA Asia.

 
 
• 
 
**Saudi Arabia** will the **host for second time** after staging the 1997 edition.
